finish_summary:
1) bulk_discount_percent returns incorrect percent for quantity 50 (spec says 10% but implementation gives 5%).
2) parse_coupon is case-sensitive and does not strip surrounding whitespace; invalid coupons raised.
3) Cart.subtotal applies wrong bulk discount logic – the computed subtotal is half of expected, implying miscalculation of unit price or quantity.
4) Cart.remove_item leaves an entry with zero quantity instead of removing the key.
5) Cart.total calls parse_coupon with raw coupon string; whitespace or case changes cause ValueError, violating spec that allows stripping and case-insensitivity.
